findings.finding: SWA text-token selection feeds prediction_head; sigmoid(pred_scores) gives one scalar text mixing weight per expression, shared across all256 Query masks.
Native fused logits are alpha*text+(1-alpha)*query, with scalar weight normalized by query_fusion_weight.
The actual matched-query fusion already receives focal and Dice supervision.
Supervised text/query/fused mask terms and consistency terms all contribute in the protected configuration; fusion is not an untrained heuristic.

interpretation: This source evidence describes the active existing path. It does not by itself attribute validation failures to alpha, branch features, or a missing loss.
